author_request: check the gangs speech fidelity, behaviors, and shit like that too

evidence.full_owner_method: Extracted exact complete logical owners from uploaded MANIFEST.yaml byte offsets and compared every inspected extraction's SHA256 with manifest; all required extracted owners matched. Read current owner and relevant mechanics, speech, psychology, relationship, presentation and routed corrections. Recent matching E30 and E31 manuscripts examined directly.
compared_delivered: S3 E30 The Right of Passage, complete manuscript
S3 E31 Dead Money, complete manuscript
evidence.qualifications: This is a targeted written-text and source-owner fidelity audit, not a measured audio performance, new exhaustive source-film transcript/actor-voice test, or certification of all seasons and every inherited sentence. E30/E31 observations cannot establish that a behavior has never occurred elsewhere. Dialogue quotations are actual recent manuscript excerpts. Only author-approved current branch controls supersede stale older labels.

overall.finding: Significant identity compression across recent ensemble episodes. Voices are superficially distinguishable but often function as a repeating exchange of one-liners, practical objection and quick punchline. The problem parallels full-kit underuse: character-rich motivation and conversational tactics are not making consequential decisions.
overall.important_positive: E31 shows actual independent roles and choices: Arthur chooses bargaining with the unpaid company, Chris notices who awaits pay and changes his shot position with Teemo, Daniel offers a split to settle a conflict, and Kaze takes the score. Preserve those causal strengths rather than replacing them with monologues.
repeated_failures: Surface tic in place of full individual voice and psychological variation
Same-scene and cross-episode joke structure repeats; characters answer each other's quips but seldom reframe the dispute or expose attachment, envy, pride or self-recognition
Scenes are constructed for basic tactical outcomes, leaving character-specific desires, arguments, affectionate/negative history and full social behavior dormant
Over-explained mechanics and detached narrator voice weaken the natural TTS listener experience

Absence of a member from a selected camera is too easily left as vague non-presence; first resolve actual availability and independent purpose before deciding whether to show them; do not invent a teleporting attendance or mandatory cast rotation

Kaze.source_truth: A self-sovereign, curious, emotionally volatile and introspective villain with explicit forty-mechanism Vaas-derived behavioral architecture, genuinely exposed thought, recursive question chains, abrupt tenderness, private amusement, voluntary antagonism, unpredictable speech cadence and agency; he can be affectionate, wrong, hurt or outtalked. Current author says he never drinks, shamelessly flirts with eligible adult women in any situation, with selected 99 percent attraction success, not a sexual consent guarantee. He may be brutally decisive but violence is not his only verb.
Kaze.positive: E31 he reacts to the loss of the proposed captive by reframing the score and takes Veylan's attack personally because Chris is threatened.
Kaze.passage: E31: 'You killed the buyer before the seller got his money'; 'I think we can rob you.' E30: brief quips to Magneto and Daniel. E31 Katarina pursuit mostly confined to a closing drink invitation.
Kaze.drift: Most dialogue is terse quip, score question or short threat. Few instances of live-discovering thoughts, manipulative intimacy, psychological questions, self-aware bad faith, sudden sincere turns or unusually exposed changing attention. His new author correction on no alcohol/flirting supersedes depicted E30 sip and prior underdeveloped Katarina flirt.
Kaze.forward: Let his own 40 mechanisms inform natural conversation and choices where triggered, especially noncombat relational stakes, risk and real curiosity. Make attraction conspicuous during actual adult-female encounters without supplanting her agency. No artificial lengthy Vaas rant or forced token questions.

Chris.source_truth: Chef, firearms technician, compulsive looter, RDR2 player, Phish fan and separate person from Billy. Theo-Von-informed storytelling uses bizarre specific sensory/person anecdotes arising from an observed concern, builds them conversationally, then can collapse into clarity, real emotion or technical precision. His relationship with Arthur, Billy and Teemo involves love, irritation, criticism and occasional vulnerability. Earned gunfighting and utility remain fully active.
Chris.positive: E31: criticizes cheap wine with a concrete grotesque comparison, identifies unpaid company's incentive, and correctly repositions before shooting after Teemo's warning. E30: salvages a practical bent sight mount.
Chris.passage: E31: 'Tastes like somebody washed a saddle in fruit'; 'I'm not conducting a fucking survey.' E30 repeatedly wants the adjustment mount despite Arthur's objections.
Chris.drift: Strong narrow chef/loot quips but too little of the unusual extended associative speaking rhythm, RDR2 as lived activity, Phish taste, engineering problem solving beyond prop retrieval, or deeper two-way bond with Billy. Teemo risks becoming generic tactical HUD with a single alert.
Chris.forward: Develop contextual verbal reasoning or one absurd remembered/hypothetical specificity when a real conversational opening exists; other people change the thought. Honor his precise competence and relationships. Never force a meme, constant game interruption or fabricated backstory.

Billy.source_truth: Independent ancient demon-yordle swamp predator and master banjo player. Cultivated double-edged Southern hospitality; greedy appetite, vanity, genuine affection, viciousness, self-serving stories, displaced glory-days nostalgia and competent selective foolishness. Common Uncle-Rico-at-the-cookout attitude; musical Primus/bluegrass/slap-banjo identity; has opinions, bargains and goals outside physical storage.
Billy.positive: E30 he objects to the 'murder souvenirs' description, E31 he comments on informality and physically swallows two chests through a valid exterior switch.
Billy.passage: E31: 'I see the evening has become informal' and 'A fine host. Everything settled before dessert.'
Billy.drift: In these episodes his outward speech is polite fish one-liners; he becomes warehouse/elevator for chests rather than someone with a persistent agenda, vanity, desire for audience, resentment, hunger, music, risk choice or sincere relationship.
Billy.forward: When actually exterior or audibly interior, give him authored independent interests and responsive bargaining/nostalgia; let genuine appetite, ancient bragging, cultivated welcome, musicianship and real choices alter what happens. Not a mandated prehistoric story or banjo song every appearance.

Daniel.source_truth: Always genuinely drunk mythic simian, intelligent and a deliberate joker in every situation. Humor and decision style blend Pete Davidson candid self-implication, Dan Cummins causal absurd-premise development and Jo Koy recognizable role reenactment/social observation into ONE Daniel, with embodied foot/tail/cloud/bottle/hair and real strategic insight. He can be mistaken, affectionate, embarrassed, quiet but still make a situational joke; he does not automatically forget his own sentences.
Daniel.positive: E30 ice-traps a soldier while saving a laborer; E31 spear acrobatics and independently proposes a paid-company split that genuinely changes outcome.
Daniel.passage: E30: 'Safety inspection. Your floor failed'; 'I was just helping the paperwork.' E31: 'Terrible onboarding. Nobody showed me the break room.'
Daniel.drift: A run of office/workplace/finance quips delivers recognizable dad-joke humor but overuses one comic register. Very little self-implicating candor, developed bizarre reasoning, role enactment, physical bits that reframe situations, or reciprocal Kaze strategic one-upmanship.
Daniel.forward: Keep the continuous humor trigger, but vary joke function, topic, emotional role and actual physical performance. He may pursue a real argument through imitation or ridiculous cause-and-effect then genuinely change a plan. Avoid forced long standup set or sober 'serious' transformation.

Arthur.source_truth: Maximum-low-honor post-rebuild Arthur, an articulate and dangerous frontier outlaw: capable of courtesy-as-bait, slyly escalating GREET/GREET/ANTAGONIZE, mock reassurance, threats, self-interest, intimate warmth, cruelty, misjudgment and genuine attachment. Not the gang's permanent ethical counselor. His full living-machine body, eye, ALL current weapons, bank and charge systems influence tactical choices.
Arthur.positive: E31 has his best causal social move in the sampled pair: deliberately unsettles Veylan's loyal company with withheld pay, takes a share as the means to get out, and preserves enough money for his own gang.
Arthur.passage: E31: 'Looks delivered'; 'I'm buying the end of an argument'; 'Pleasure doing business.' E30: 'Find yourself somewhere else.'
Arthur.drift: Recent dialogue often simplifies him to calm, practical reasonable negotiator, against a broad lower-honor playful, sly, coercive and sometimes genuinely nasty character. His smoking, voice range and cybernetic observation are not visibly used, even where relevant. Source also permits lengthy articulate exchanges and occasional losing the argument, not only clipped one-liners.
Arthur.forward: Retain exact source Arthur cadence/range without quote mining or an impersonation. Let warm insult, planted social trap, threats, frontier analogy, body language and reactive misjudgment emerge from his wants; visible eye/gun tactics should materially change his talking and decisions, not merely his firepower.

Zid.source_truth: Same continuing Zion fused with Sid, one Sid-dominant person with Zion's history, conspiratorial self-preservation and lazy evasions underneath. Hungry-for-approval Jerry-like relational role, eager but botched RDR2 references, lumbago-only optional game trait; may be right or useful, not a permanent punchline or secret genius.
Zid.passage: Zid does not appear or speak in the sampled E30 and E31 manuscripts.
Zid.drift: No recent voice or independent behavior can be measured. His absence is a coverage/evidence question, not proof he was physically available or should have appeared in these scenes. Must not fabricate current position or infer automatic gang attendance.
Zid.forward: Resolve actual matching-branch last location/access before staging. When eligible, let a desire for inclusion or respect drive an actual choice, not a mandatory humiliation. Preserve Sid-dominant voice, older Zion memory and real agency.

cross_character.group: Outlaw chosen family with no permanent commander. Their motives vary; each may initiate a score, refuse, instigate, escalate or protect. Genuine private affection and competition can coexist with extreme crimes. Their common reward/pay division uses current distinct 60/40 job rule when a legitimate job leader and participants exist. No equal reaction queue.
cross_character.scene_finding: E30 most cast lines revolve around Kaze/Arthur/Chris/Daniel making adjacent quips at a separate character's local problem; E31's selected ransom becomes a gang-owned score and has better agency but still leaves much inter-character history idle.
cross_character.repair: Let meaningful interpersonal exchanges change the operation, loyalties, possession or resentment. Start jokes from lived preferences/relationships, and allow quiet warmth, genuinely funny winning and angry disagreement to develop without compulsory equal participation. Never manufacture an exact Zid position to fill the scene.

Black_Mimir.finding: E30 narratorial 'Aye. No sacred sporting interval...' and E31 'I'd been wondering...' offer fragments, but much narration is neutral battle prose. Scottish-and-Chicago individual wit, personal judgment and fallibility barely anchor the experience. It would be incorrect to add omniscient knowledge or profanity/ethnic address by quota.
Black_Mimir.repair: Use identifiable first-person texture, interpretive error and correction, humane insight and distinctive transition to orient new listener while leaving action geography and event truth intact.

Teemo.finding: E31 tactical explanation changes Chris's choice, which is good; his broader resentment, persona and relationship with Chris are not meaningfully present in these two episodes. Do not inflate him into automatic aim control or another member.
Teemo.repair: Write his own independent judgments, teasing, grievances or selective cooperation when actual communication and motive allow; keep one soul-consciousness and source-valid scope.

checks: Before prose, identify each materially active person's immediate want, vulnerability, habit, social tactic, complete voice owner and real prior relationship with the actual listener.
Test whether another speaker's response genuinely changes intention, mood, trust, threat or available options; distinguish developed humor from an interchangeable joke queue.
Do not insert speech quotas, simultaneous cast cameos, twenty-first-century references without actor knowledge, direct celebrity impersonation or narrator exposition of production rules.
Preserve Black Mimir solely in ordinary main narration, distinct Billy first-person Specials, actual TTS readability and BELLY audio/visual/one-exterior geometry.

After full draft, compare concrete lines/actions with actual owners; repair tone and behavior without eliminating available kit, plot tension or causal accuracy. Reopen and reread full corrected manuscript.
